content.value_statement: React components often grow effects, refs, and props that are hard to maintain. This skill gives concise patterns for safer hooks and clearer component design.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use effects and when to avoid them.
Shows patterns for useMemo, key props, updater functions, and useEffectEvent.
Guides safe ref usage for DOM nodes, timers, and dynamic lists.
Defines custom hook naming and scope recommendations.
Covers controlled components, composition, and provider boundaries.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, but it does not run tests or linters.
It focuses on React component patterns, not full application architecture.
It assumes modern React and TypeScript workflows.
It does not replace version-specific React documentation.

use_cases.title: Review Existing Components
use_cases.description: Identify unnecessary effects, derived state, and missing cleanup before refactoring a component.

use_cases.title: Design Shared UI APIs
use_cases.description: Choose controlled, uncontrolled, compound, or composed component patterns for reusable UI.

use_cases.title: Guide AI Pair Programming
use_cases.description: Give Claude, Codex, or Claude Code clear React rules before editing component files.

prompt_templates.title: Check an Effect
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React component and tell me if each Effect is necessary. Suggest a render-time calculation or event handler when appropriate.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor State Reset
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this component so state resets correctly when props change. Prefer key-based resets or controlled state before adding an Effect.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Custom Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a focused custom hook for this behavior. Explain which state is shared as logic and which state stays independent per hook call.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Component API
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of reusable UI design
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this reusable React component API. Look for boolean prop switches, prop drilling, provider boundaries, and better composition options.

output_examples.input: A component stores a full name in state and updates it with an Effect.
output_examples.output: The review recommends calculating the full name during render and removing redundant state.

output_examples.input: A list component needs a reference to each rendered item.
output_examples.output: The guidance recommends ref callbacks for dynamic lists instead of calling refs inside a loop.

output_examples.input: A shared component has several boolean props that switch large UI sections.
output_examples.output: The review suggests separate composed components or a compound component pattern for clearer usage.

best_practices: Use effects only to synchronize with systems outside React.
Use refs for mutable values that should not trigger rendering.
Prefer composition and clear state ownership over broad optional props.
anti_patterns: Using effects for derived values that can be calculated during render.
Suppressing exhaustive dependency lint rules instead of fixing dependencies.
Creating lifecycle-style hooks that hide missing dependency problems.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when reading or writing React components with hooks, refs, effects, or reusable UI patterns.

faq.question: Does it write React code for me?
faq.answer: It provides patterns and examples that an AI coding tool can apply while editing your project.

faq.question: Does it require TypeScript?
faq.answer: The guidance pairs well with TypeScript, but many patterns also apply to JavaScript React components.

faq.question: Can it replace the React documentation?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes practical patterns and should be used with official React documentation for version details.

faq.question: What problems does it help prevent?
faq.answer: It helps prevent unnecessary effects, stale dependencies, unsafe ref usage, and unclear component APIs.

faq.question: Is it safe for marketplace publication?
faq.answer: The reviewed content is documentation only. Static command and reconnaissance alerts were false positives.
